summary: Iteration 9 tested the backend and frontend: the emotion picker, the reveal choreography, the no-scroll question screens, the /bands reorder screen, the story video, plus regression. Backend: 5/5 pytest pass. POST /api/husbands took 4.3s, the band order is kept, the card is stored in the background within seconds, and card.jpg and og.jpg return 200. Frontend: everything passes except one no-scroll check. On /strand/5 (Temperament) at 1280x720 and 1440x900 the CTA sits below the fold and the page scrolls; at 1920x1080 the CTA only just fits but the page still scrolls by 32px. Strands 1-4, 6 and 7 fit at all 3 desktop sizes, and WovenProgress is hidden on desktop. At 390x844 the fixed strand-cta-bar is visible at scrollY=0 on every strand. scrollY resets to 0 on each route change. Bands, reveal, emotions, video, Tell, the public /h/:id page, reweave and the sound toggle all work with no console errors.

minor.issue: Emergent LLM key budget is used up (backend log: 'Budget has been exceeded! Max budget: 0.4'). Every husband currently gets template vows (vows_source=template). The fallback works, but there are no LLM vows until the key is topped up.

ui_bugs.issue: No-scroll requirement not met. At 1280x720 the CTA top/bottom is 1013/1069 with scrollHeight 1090. At 1440x900 it is 1018/1074 with scrollHeight 1101. At 1920x1080 scrollHeight is 1112 > 1080 and the CTA bottom is 1079. Cause: 3 slider cards (~170px each), title, so-far tags, then the hoop-small art and 'coming together' line, all with no lg or max-height compaction.

issues: The 'Heart eyes' label wraps onto 2 lines at 10px, which makes the row look uneven. Use 'Hearts' or allow a wider cell.

The WovenProgress row ('Your husband so far / None of VII strands') shows faintly behind the gradient of the fixed CTA bar at scrollY=0. It looks clipped. Hide it under 1024px or add more bottom spacing.

The route exit transition shifts the whole timeline by about 0.4s. At 5.5s after the URL change the signature is at opacity 0.42; it is fully visible at about 6.2s, and the share button too (0.98). Acceptable, slightly behind the spec.

action_items: Make /strand/5 Temperament fit at 1280x720, 1440x900 and 1920x1080: on lg hide the hoop-small/comingTogether block, and maybe the so-far tags, or tighten slider card padding and space-y under a max-height media query. This keeps next-remembers-button inside the viewport and scrollHeight <= innerHeight.
Top up the Emergent LLM key budget (vows currently always come from templates).
Optional: shorten the 'Heart eyes' label; hide WovenProgress peeking behind the phone CTA bar.
critical_code_review_comments: Bands.jsx: the useEffect has no deps and runs on every render (cheap because it is guarded, but it should use [ready, answers.bandPick]).
Bands.jsx: if she changes answers after picking, bandPick keeps stale labels. They are filtered out at render, but the stored state is never cleaned up.
VowsCard under reduced motion still plays the 0.6s clip-write and 0.5s signature fade. Fine, but motion is not fully removed.
Font preload warnings: CormorantGaramond-500-italic and GrenzeGotisch-600 are preloaded but not used on some routes.

rca of the issue: On desktop, Temperament.jsx renders its whole stack in the right column: StrandHeader, h1, sub, 3 Slider cards, so-far tags, the hoop-small Art with the 'coming together' text, then StrandCTA (mt-5). Unlike Strand.jsx, where Aside is hidden at max-height 820 and WovenProgress is lg:hidden, nothing here is compacted on lg, so the content is about 1090px tall. Fix: add lg:hidden to the hoop-small block, and possibly the so-far tags, or apply [@media(max-height:900px)] compaction.
